name: Romantic Comedy
definition: A central romance develops through comic incompatibility, social performance, and escalating misunderstanding until honesty reorganizes both the couple and their community.
negative_signals: humiliation with no affection or repair
diagnostic_questions: Does comedy expose the partners' defenses and social assumptions?
Would resolving the romance also resolve the main comic disorder?

neighbors.distinction: Romantic comedy makes comic social disorder a primary engine, not merely tonal relief.
Its central resolution is the chosen couple and their social reintegration.

reader_promises.name: Comic chemistry
reader_promises.description: Create attraction through conflicting methods, timing, language, or social roles.

reader_promises.name: Joyful relational resolution
reader_promises.description: Resolve central misunderstanding with earned honesty, choice, and communal release.

roles.name: Performing partner
roles.description: Uses a social mask or strategy that creates both appeal and comic trouble.

roles.name: Disrupting partner
roles.description: Exposes or counters the first partner's performance while hiding another vulnerability.

roles.name: Social mirror
roles.description: Amplifies, misreads, or comments on the couple's contradictions.

settings: Tightly connected neighborhood or friend group
motifs: Public and private versions of the same person

movements.name: Comic meeting
movements.description: Create attraction and friction through a consequential mismatch.

movements.name: Entanglement
movements.description: Force repeated cooperation while social performances become harder to maintain.

movements.name: Public tangle
movements.description: Converge misunderstandings so private fears become visible and choices cause comic fallout.

movements.name: Honest union
movements.description: Resolve the romance through changed conduct and a socially legible choice.

complications.name: Role collision
complications.description: Two incompatible public identities must operate in the same scene.

complications.name: Help backfires
complications.description: A friend's reasonable intervention worsens misunderstanding.

complications.name: Real opportunity
complications.description: A comic deception unexpectedly creates a valuable career or social choice.

twists.name: The other knew
twists.description: One partner recognized the performance but waited for honest self-disclosure.

twists.name: Rival becomes ally
twists.description: The apparent romantic competitor supports the healthier union.

conclusions.name: Celebratory union
conclusions.description: The couple commits and the ensemble reorganizes around the truth.

conclusions.name: Private union
conclusions.description: The couple rejects spectacle and chooses a credible quieter relationship.

conclusions.name: Community renewal
conclusions.description: Romantic honesty also repairs a workplace, family, or social group.

subversions: Let characters communicate early and generate comedy from difficult honest choices.
Make the grand gesture a precise act of listening rather than spectacle.
cliches_to_avoid: A removable misunderstanding stretched by implausible silence
quality_checks: Comic setbacks arise from character goals.
Both partners remain sympathetic without being flawless.
The final union resolves the behavior exposed by the comedy.

sources.title: The Cambridge Companion to Popular Fiction
sources.contribution: Supports romance and comic complication as flexible repertoires of reader pleasure.

sources.title: Genre as Convention and Invention
sources.contribution: Explains genre through recurring expectations that works can satisfy, combine, or deliberately frustrate.
